Package org.example.model

Class PresetConfig

java.lang.Object
org.example.model.PresetConfig
public class PresetConfig extends Object
Model entity representing a simulation parameter configuration preset stored in the preset_configs database table.

Encapsulates setup parameters including customer arrival mean, station resource capacities (ovens, dining tables, couriers), ordering probabilities, and average service durations across service points.

  • Constructor Details

    • PresetConfig

      public PresetConfig()
      Default no-argument constructor for Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) and manual instantiation.

    • PresetConfig

      public PresetConfig(String configName, double arrivalMean, int oven1Capacity, int oven2Capacity, int tableCapacity, int courierCapacity, double drinkProbability, double oven1ServiceTime, double oven2ServiceTime, double tableServiceTime, double courierServiceTime)
      Parameterized constructor for creating a new preset configuration entity prior to database insertion.
      Parameters:
      configName - Unique descriptive label for the preset.
      arrivalMean - Mean inter-arrival time for arriving customers.
      oven1Capacity - Maximum parallel capacity for Oven 1.
      oven2Capacity - Maximum parallel capacity for Oven 2.
      tableCapacity - Maximum seating capacity for dining tables.
      courierCapacity - Maximum active couriers for delivery.
      drinkProbability - Probability of a customer purchasing a drink (0.0 to 1.0).
      oven1ServiceTime - Mean service duration for Oven 1.
      oven2ServiceTime - Mean service duration for Oven 2.
      tableServiceTime - Mean service duration for dining tables.
      courierServiceTime - Mean service duration for delivery couriers.
